Welcome to the '''MirkLurk Wiki''', an independent guide to the Mirk.

'''MirkLurk''' is a turn-based, single-player survival RPG by [https://edympixels.com/ Edym Pixels], in Early Access on [https://store.steampowered.com/app/3972980/MirkLurk/ Steam] since 11 June 2026. Exiled to the Mirk, a hostile swampland, you spend [[Action points|action points]] on every step, fight and harvest while keeping yourself fed, rested and warm.

'''Current version:''' 0.9.2.0, the patch of 29 October 2026. See [[Version 0.9.2.0|what's new in 0.9.2.0]] or [[Versions|every version]].

'''Spoilers:''' this wiki includes story events, locations and discoveries.
